text:
customer-delta: Quick presales note - our game has thousands of ephemeral match keys (10k+ principals). We need BYOK (CloudHSM) with KEK rotation every 4h, per-key audit, and weneed a realistic cost/latency projection before legal signs SOW.
sam-presales: heads-up: cardinality matters. If each principal unwraps frequently, unwrap ops explode. We should run a focused POC to measure unwrap/sec with different cache_ttl and principal sharding.
ivy-se: proposed quick experiment for POC - three axes: cache_ttl (15s/60s/300s), principal-cardinality (100/1k/10k), and rotation cadence (4h + jitter). We'll run perf runs and produce a heatmap of p50 vs unwraps/sec.
ivy-se: sample sidecar snippet we'll deploy for the POC:
```yaml
sidecar:
  cache_ttl: 60s # tuneable per-run
  max_unwrapped_keys: 20
  mem_lock: true
rotation:
  cron: "0 */4 * * *"
  jitter_pct: 10
```
sam-presales: billing note: key-op charges multiply with unwraps. We'll include cost-breakdown in SOW. If unwrap/sec goes high, Dedicated contract or an enterprise add-on can cap per-op billing.
mohit-security: auditors want: HSM attestation docs (vendor cert), signed proof-of-possession, and immutable per-op logs (event, key_id, principal, ts, request_id). For high cardinality, ensure logs are compressed and delivered in batch to your SIEM.
customer-delta: can you paste one sample audit line we can drop into Splunk?
ivy-se: example single-line JSON log: {"ts":"2026-08-21T18:22:11Z","event":"unwrap","key_id":"delta/prod/kek-2026-08","principal":"ephemeral/pu-4521","request_id":"r_ab12","src":"10.4.5.6"}
sam-presales: POC plan (2.5 weeks):
- Day 0: kickoff, exchange FW & attestation needs
- Day 2: deploy sidecar matrix (cache_ttl variants) to staging and baseline perf
- Day 5: run cardinality sweep (100/1k/10k principals) and capture unwrap/sec + p50/p95
- Day 10: rotation stress (4h cadence x72h) with jitter, collect cost delta and error patterns
- Day 15: deliver heatmaps, sample attestation bundle, and recommended config for production

sam-presales: action items: @ivy-se to push perf harness and dashboards, @mohit-security to attach attestation sample and log schema, @customer-delta to confirm expected average QPS and peak concurrent principals.
ops-bot: deploy-status: key-proxy v1.3 staged to stg-cardinality at 2026-08-21T18:30:00Z :white_check_mark:
ivy-se: I'll include a perf harness flag to vary principal reuse ratio (reuse_rate=0.9 to 0.01) so we can show real unwrap scaling.
customer-delta: thanks, please include a cost model table in the deliverable (unwraps/sec -> monthly TCO). If POC shows cache_ttl=60s and reuse_rate>=0.5 meets ~15ms p50, we can proceed.
mohit-security: also note: for FIPS customers we'll enable FIPS-mode build of sidecar and include that in attestation bundle.
sam-presales: perfect. We'll aim to have the SOW draft and perf plan by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
